entry.title: 2310/20 [sscl] new: Return of Social Security Contribution Levy
entry.content:
The Commissioner General of Inland Revenue has specified the return form for Social Security Contribution Levy. Businesses liable for the levy must submit a completed return for each quarter beginning on or after 1 October 2022, by the 20th day of the month following that quarter. The form records monthly turnover, tax calculations and credits, and warns that penalties may apply for incorrect or late returns and non-payment.
Effective from 2022-12-14.
Affects: businesses liable to the Social Security Contribution Levy.
Source: https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/Gazette_Documents/2022_2310-20_E.pdf
